name: game-jam-mode
description: > Coaches a game jam entry from rules to submission: reads the ruleset and AI policy, interprets the theme, locks scope, runs an hour-by-hour plan with agent-assisted building, and submits a browser build with accurate AI disclosure. Use for "game jam", "Ludum Dare", "GMTK", "Vibe Jam", "js13k", "48 hours". Not for a build with no jam deadline (use game-vibe-code).
author: AlterLab-IEU
